title: Electromax Demand Flashing | Electric Heating Guide
description: Distinguish Electromax heating demand, start-up and persistent flashing using the correct model manual. Arrange competent electrical heating assessment.
answer: The Electromax manufacturer fault charts distinguish persistent demand flashing from supply and alarm paths. Match the model before drawing a conclusion.

sections.heading: A condition, not a universal numeric code
paragraphs: Electromax combines different functions. A heating-demand indicator concerns the electric-boiler path, while off-peak hot water can fail for a different reason. The cited manual has a separate diagnostic route where demand remains flashing beyond the initial period.

sections.heading: What to record
paragraphs: Record the installed radiator or underfloor configuration, visible indicator, which heating function fails and whether domestic hot water still works. Do not remove panels or apply the Amptec top/bottom red-light table to Electromax.

sections.heading: Competent assessment
paragraphs: Internal supply, control and element checks require appropriate electrical and heating competence. Public guidance here is limited to identification and enquiry preparation, not live testing or component replacement.

faqs.question: Can I use the Amptec red-light table to diagnose Electromax demand flashing?
faqs.answer: No. Match the Electromax model and its own diagnostic charts; similar manufacturer branding does not establish identical controls.
